messages:
alex: starting handoff, taking the 22:00->06:00 shift. Heads-up: we had a relay queue pager earlier, I put a short mitigation in place and left notes. handing off primary to @maria in 5.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] relay-queue: enqueue latency >250ms for 6m (P2) — INC-2026-78 — https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-78 :rotating_light:

alex: timeline quick summary:
- 21:12 first spike in enqueue latencies (EU region)
- 21:18 automated autoscaler tried to spin up new pods but saw cold-start backlog
- 21:25 I bumped dedicated pool (redwood-dedicated-3) replicas + disabled autobatching on EU ingress as a mitigation
- 21:34 enqueue latency returned to baseline but we saw a ~3% 503s for autocomplete calls for ~20m

maria: thanks — any customer-facing comms needed? which customers saw 503s?

alex: small set of EU customers; partner-integrations and one ecommerce beta customer. I left a health check that reports affected routes in the incident ticket. No global outage, limited degraded tail latency.

raj: can you paste the commands / logs you used so we have them in the thread? also runbook pointer pls.

alex: pasted below — runbook used: https://redwood.runbooks/relay-latency (see section: "KV cache thrash")

```
# scale pool to add capacity
redwoodctl pool scale --pool redwood-dedicated-3 --replicas 2

# disable autobatching on EU ingress to reduce tail latency
redwoodctl config set ingress.eu.autobatch false

# quick tail of relay logs (filtered)
kubectl -n relay logs -l app=relay --tail=200 | grep -i "enqueue latency" | tail -n 50
```

logs snippet:
```
[21:15:02] relay-0 enqueue latency=312ms kv-cache-miss=1 backpressure=1
[21:15:06] relay-1 enqueue latency=328ms kv-cache-miss=3 backpressure=1
[21:22:10] relay-0 enqueue latency=265ms kv-cache-miss=0 backpressure=0
```

alex: root cause suspicion: KV cache thrash when a small subset of long context requests cause frequent eviction + cache rebuilds on EU pool. The autoscaler start cycle + cold start increased enqueue times temporarily. Runbook suggests either: (a) temper autobatch settings, (b) pin hot keys to local cache, (c) increase pool cushion. I did (a) + temporary (c).

taylor: nice. any metrics to watch overnight?

alex: watch these dashboards:
- EU relay enqueue p50/p95/p99: https://console.redwood/dash/relay-eu
- KV cache hit ratio: https://console.redwood/dash/kv-cache
- 503 rate by route: https://console.redwood/dash/errors-by-route

I also added a lightweight alert for KV-cache hit ratio drop below 70% for >5m (RDW-ALERT-128).

maria: ok taking primary now. alex — passing any open mitigations to me?

alex: yes:
- mitigation applied: pool scaled and autobatch disabled (command above)
- temp: I left a canary route on to confirm the fix — canary is at /canary/autocomplete-eu
- followups: create ticket for stricter autoscaler cold-start sniffing and a proper fix for hot-key pinning (RDW-4321). I filed RDW-4321 with initial notes.

raj: is there a post-handoff action chain? who owns RDW-4321?

alex: I'm listing owners in the ticket: primary owner @maria, backend owner @raj, runtime / infra owner @taylor. Ticket link: https://jira.redwood/browse/RDW-4321

maria: ack, I'm owning RDW-4321. I'll schedule a quick retro. When's good?

alex: Friday 10:00 PT works for me. If that works for you @taylor and @raj, please accept calendar invite I just sent.

raj: accepted. I'll add initial notes about autoscaler heuristics and cold-start mitigation experiments.

sre-bot: created follow-up ticket RDW-4321; added label: oncall-followup.

maria: immediate on-call checklist for tonight (quick bullets):
- monitor the three dashboards alex linked, escalate if enqueue p95 >200ms for >10m
- verify canary route success, check logs for 5xx
- if errors reappear, re-enable earlier config and open INC-2026-78 to SEV2 ops (we already have it open)

alex: additional context for handoff:
- who is primary: @maria (now)
- who is secondary: @raj (reach out if primary unavailable)
- coverage gap: none currently but note that APAC capacity is low tonight — avoid heavy maintenance on APAC pools until 06:00 PT
- runbook pointer again: https://redwood.runbooks/relay-latency section 'Mitigations for KV cache thrash'

maria: thanks. I have control plane creds for scaling and will be on slack for the next 45m. alex — if you need to re-engage, ping me.

alex: will do. last notes: added synthetic test that pings /canary/autocomplete-eu every 30s (temp) to catch regressions; will remove after 24h if stable.

maria: ok taking over. will post an update if anything changes. low-pri followups: (1) RDW-4321 detailed plan, (2) Autoscaler cold-start postmortem item, (3) add a permanent KV cache metric to the SLO dashboard.

raj: thanks all. adding my tech notes to RDW-4321 now.

alex: handing off — good night, bump me if needed. :wave:
